title: Taiheiyo Cement reports drop in profits for 2026 financial year
summary: Taiheiyo Cement reports drop in profits for 2026 financial year
body_markdown:
**Japan:** Taiheiyo Cement announced its financial results on 10 November 2026. The company reported a drop in profit for the second quarter of the financial year ending 30 September 2026, decreasing by 12.8% year-on-year to US$181.6m. The 2026 forecast for consolidated profit has decreased by 20.7% year-on-year, from the previous forecast of US$442.9m to US$351m.


In the second quarter of 2026, from July to September 2026, the consolidated ordinary profit decreased to US$103.7m, a 28.5% drop year-on-year compared to the same period in 2025. The operating profit margin decreased from 10% in the corresponding period in 2025 to 7.6%.
